scope: Existing-wallet Preview bootstrap, persistence and controlled full-swap composition plus package command wiring. Source-only, no CLI execution or actual resource approval.

findings.title: Final directory fsync can cross cleanup deadline and still report PERSISTED
findings.evidence: Independent connected synthetic-file reproducer instruments the final real fsync after pending marker removal to advance Date.now to deadline+1. Exact current helper returns {status:PERSISTED,children:3} instead of rejecting PREVIEW_LAUNCH_DEADLINE. Earlier deadline checks and standard tests do not cover this final boundary.
findings.requiredCorrection: Check deadline after the final directory sync before returning success. Preserve original negative evidence and add connected final-fsync lateness control. The completed consistent file set need not be rolled back or represented as a mixed pending state; distinguish completed writes from on-time success.
findings.impact: A purported five-second bounded persistence success can be reported after its supplied deadline. No actual wallet or operational run was involved; this finding does not claim snapshot corruption or false Preview financial acceptance.

checkedScope: Public plan, retained build/runtime and genesis preflight precede private preparation. Output and contract-store directories are exclusive. Pending persistence marker refuses private reads/restore. All three existing snapshot envelopes are read/validated before HD derivation or facade initialization; missing/invalid state has no create fallback.

SDK Preview selection, derived Bech32/native payer and signing identity precede wallet start. Restored unshielded state network/address/key is matched. Connected progress, DUST availability and no pending coin/DUST state precede integration.

Native pre-submit retention and corrected public boundary02 integrate through the existing exported helpers. Package preview command requires explicit run/plan/hash arguments; import is inert. CLI was not run.

Persistence serializes all three SDK state strings, verifies original private bytes, writes/fsyncs an exclusive backup and all three replacement envelopes, creates/fsyncs pending marker before any rename, verifies replacements, syncs parent, then removes marker. Interrupted second rename preserves original backups and pending marker; another launch fails closed.
Wallet stop remains in finally if persistence fails. Outer process/service containment remains a separate obligation.

Controlled full swap composition invokes actual native observer/comparator/minted-coin gate against retained local transactions and reconstructed synthetic-capability state; it is not actual Preview financial execution.
limitations: Candidate requires correction and independent review before source approval; no operative bootstrap or resource run approved.
Exclusive admitted wallet use, trusted filesystem, original state/role provenance and current Preview chain/protocol compatibility remain launcher/admission assumptions requiring concrete binding.
Serialization does not prove all children represent the same chain height; pending marker provides interrupted file-set detection only.
Only synthetic test directories and public retained fixtures were used. No original private data, live RPC/network, wallet operation, services, proofs, compilation or transaction submission.
All Preview financial and mandatory PCD hard gates remain open.
